newsitem.title: USA: CUSCo, Pa. utility says it approved to sell power.
newsitem.headline: CUSCo, Pa. utility says it approved to sell power.

text.p: Competitive Utility Services Corp (CUSCo) said it was approved by Pennsylvania Public Utility Commission to sell electricity to wholesale and retail customers nationwide.
CUSCo is a for-profit subsidiary of Pennsylvania Rural Electric Association, which represents the 14 electric co-operatives in Pennsylvania and New Jersey, the company said in a statement.
"We intend to participate as a competing generation supplier in several customer choice pilot programs being launched," CUSCo said.

Beginning in 1999, about one-third of Pennsylvania's electric customers will be able to shop for the best price in power generation, and by 2001, all Pennsylvanians will be able to choose the company that generates their electricity.
